segments.name: China
segments.description: The company's operations in the People's Republic of China, reviewed by the CODM as a separate operating segment.
segments.evidence: Based on management's assessment, the Company has determined that it has two reportable segments: China and the United States.

segments.name: United States and others
segments.description: The company's operations in the United States and other immaterial operations, reviewed by the CODM as a separate operating segment.
segments.evidence: Based on management's assessment, the Company has determined that it has two operating segments, China and the United States and others.
